_readme: Every swappable asset in the video. To swap: drop the file in video/assets/, set its 'file' (path relative to video/assets/) or 'value', and set status to 'ready'. Status: ready = real asset in use; placeholder = stand-in drawn by the animation; confirm = filled in but needs the user's OK; not available = deliberately using the drawn fallback. Screenshots may carry an optional crop {x, y, w} (fractions of the image). Only 'ready' (or 'confirm') entries are used; placeholders render as clearly labelled slots.

music.bed.need: Bed track: warm, hopeful acoustic/piano, soft percussion, ~90-110 BPM, >= 2:40 long, royalty-free and cleared for this use. Put it in video/assets/music/, set 'file' (e.g. 'music/bed.mp3') and status 'ready'. Settings in 'value': lufs = the track's integrated loudness (npm run music:measure prints it; null assumes -14); underVoDb / holdDb = music loudness relative to the VO while it speaks / in the three no-VO holds; hits.M1-M3 = optional time (s) in the track of a beat drop / swell / final chord to land on that hold (the track is spliced under the VO before each hold to make it land). Without a ready file the video renders without music. Read by src/Soundtrack.tsx.

generated._note: Everything else on screen is drawn procedurally in src/kit (paper grain via SVG feTurbulence, tape, pins, paperclip, stamps, marker and pencil strokes, the thread, all doodles). No third-party images are used.
generated.fonts: Caveat, Courier Prime, Inter (OFL 1.1) and Permanent Marker (Apache 2.0) for the scrapbook; project brand fonts Instrument Serif, Literata, Geist, Newsreader (all OFL 1.1). All bundled from npm @fontsource packages.
